result.summary: The pedestrian environment is highly hostile due to a complete lack of dedicated infrastructure, including sidewalks and marked crossings. Pedestrians are forced to walk on unpaved grass or in the roadway, which is in poor condition with visible cracking.

hazards.name: Missing Sidewalks
hazards.description: Complete absence of paved walkways forces pedestrians into the roadway or onto uneven grass.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curb line throughout the scene.

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crossings
hazards.description: No designated crossing points are provided, increasing risk for pedestrians attempting to cross the roadway.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct a continuous paved sidewalk along the roadway to provide a safe, separated space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks and Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install high-visibility marked crosswalks and ADA-compliant curb ramps at logical crossing points.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is highly deficient, lacking sidewalks, marked crossings, and adequate lighting. Pedestrians are forced to share the roadway with vehicles or navigate unpaved grassy areas, while the pavement itself is in poor condition.

hazards.name: Missing Sidewalks
hazards.description: Complete absence of paved walkways forces pedestrians into the roadway or onto uneven grass.
hazards.location_in_image: Both sides of the roadway throughout the frame.

hazards.name: Poor Pavement Condition
hazards.description: Significant cracking and degradation of the asphalt surface create trip hazards and may affect vehicle handling.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and middle ground of the roadway.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct continuous, ADA-compliant sidewalks on both sides of the street to provide physical separation for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks and Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install high-visibility marked crosswalks and curb ramps at the intersection to provide a designated and accessible crossing point.

result.summary: The environment is highly hostile to pedestrians, lacking sidewalks, marked crossings, and any form of separation from vehicular traffic. Pedestrians are forced to share the roadway with vehicles on a surface with significant pavement degradation and cracking.

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian facilities
hazards.description: No sidewalks or designated walking paths exist, forcing pedestrians to walk directly in the travel lane.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire length of the roadway on both sides

hazards.name: Degraded pavement
hazards.description: Significant cracking and surface deterioration create trip hazards and may cause vehicles to swerve unexpectedly.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and middle ground of the roadway

hazards.name: Visual obstructions from parked vehicles
hazards.description: Vehicles parked along the right side of the road block sightlines between drivers and anyone attempting to cross or walk along the edge.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the road in the middle ground

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct paved sidewalks on at least one side of the road to provide physical separation between pedestrians and motor vehicles.

interventions.title: Pavement Rehabilitation
interventions.description: Resurface the roadway to eliminate cracks and potholes, improving safety for all users.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks and Signage
interventions.description: Install high-visibility marked crosswalks and pedestrian crossing warning signs to alert drivers to the presence of people crossing.

result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection with a sidewalk on one side and a faded transverse crosswalk across the side street. The main roadway lacks marked pedestrian crossings, and the existing markings are significantly worn, reducing visibility for drivers.

hazards.name: Faded crosswalk markings
hazards.description: The transverse crosswalk lines across the side street are heavily worn and difficult to see.

hazards.name: Uncontrolled main road crossing
hazards.description: There is no marked crossing or signage for pedestrians wishing to cross the main two-lane road.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the image, across the main road.

interventions.title: High-visibility crosswalk markings
interventions.description: Replace faded transverse lines with continental or ladder-style markings to increase visibility.

interventions.title: Curb extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and slow turning vehicles.
